detection_opportunities.rationale: Credentials stolen from the metadata service through SSRF are then used from the attacker's infrastructure; CloudTrail shows the instance role's session calling AWS from a foreign IP.
detection_opportunities.suggested_rule: Deploy Sigma rule d80402fa-cecd-5444-8fb6-049a22020fd1 (aws/cloudtrail logs). findings.title: Workflow relies on default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions
evidence: .github/workflows/pr.yml:3 [job(s) 'build' (no permissions: block)] — no top-level or job permissions: block — the GITHUB_TOKEN gets the repo/org default on an untrusted trigger (pull_request_target)
